steps.observation: Work on this for 30 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Three major causes of World War I were:

1. Militarism  
   European powers engaged in an arms race, expanding and modernizing their armies and navies, which made war more likely and more devastating once it began.

2. Alliance System  
   A complex web of treaties—most notably the Triple Entente (France, Britain, Russia) versus the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy)—meant that a conflict involving one country could quickly draw in its partners.

3. Nationalism  
   Intense national pride and competing national ambitions—especially in the Balkans where Slavic peoples sought independence from Austria-Hungary—heightened tensions and fostered rivalries between the great powers.
